decisions.text: Chose retainer-first pricing over hourly for new Northslope clients to smooth out feast-famine income.
Decided Fieldnote v1 ships local-first with an optional sync layer, rather than cloud-first.
Chose to hold base mileage before speed work; tempo sessions start mid-July.
Set the emergency-fund target at six months of expenses, auto-funded from every invoice.
Locked a one-essay-per-fortnight cadence with a protected morning drafting block.
Named the studio Northslope and registered the domain.

mistakes.text: Over-engineered the Fieldnote sync layer before validating the core note-taking loop; simplified back to local-first.
Ramped weekly mileage too fast and felt a shin niggle; dialed back and added a rest day.
Under-scoped a fixed-price project and ate the overrun; moved to retainers.
Waited for inspiration instead of protecting the drafting block, and missed a publish date.

learnings.title: Local-first beats cloud-first for v1
learnings.feedback: Shipped faster and testers loved the offline behavior.
learnings.summary: Starting Fieldnote local-first removed a whole class of sync bugs and let the first cohort try it within a week. Sync can be layered on later without rework.

learnings.title: Retainers smooth the runway
learnings.feedback: Two months in, income variance is way down.
learnings.summary: Trading a few high hourly rates for predictable monthly retainers made the whole business calmer and easier to plan.

learnings.title: Aerobic base before speed
learnings.summary: Weeks of easy running lowered resting heart rate and made the first tempo session feel manageable rather than punishing.

sessions.title: Fieldnote sync engine spike
sessions.body: Spent the morning spiking the offline sync engine for Fieldnote. Landed on a local-first design with a lightweight change log that can replay to a server later. Pulled scope back from a full CRDT to a simpler last-write-wins with per-field timestamps for v1. Next: wire the change log into the editor and add a conflict banner.

sessions.title: Portfolio redesign verify pass
sessions.body: Finished the studio portfolio redesign and ran a verification pass across breakpoints and both themes. Fixed two contrast issues and a layout shift on the case-study grid. The new landing copy reads more clearly with the two people I showed it to.

sessions.title: Essay drafting block
sessions.body: Protected the morning block and drafted essay #11 to completion. Held the fortnightly cadence. Captured three ideas for future essays in the notes inbox.
